template.description: Decompose a manufacturing theme by process flow, key equipment, materials, process control, yield bottlenecks, localization, and customer verification cycles.

steps.title: Define manufacturing process flow
steps.purpose: Set the product boundary and order the process stages from input material to qualified output.
quality_gates: The process sequence must cover every stage required for qualified output.

steps.title: Map key equipment
steps.purpose: Identify the equipment controlling throughput, precision, reliability, contamination, or process stability at each stage.
quality_gates: Equipment relevance must be tied to a named process stage and function.

steps.title: Map key materials
steps.purpose: Identify materials, consumables, components, and purity requirements that determine process output.
quality_gates: Material claims must state specification and process use, not only category names.

steps.title: Map process control and software
steps.purpose: Identify inspection, metrology, control software, recipes, and data systems that stabilize production.
quality_gates: Process-control value must link to yield, throughput, reliability, or qualification evidence.

steps.title: Locate yield and throughput bottlenecks
steps.purpose: Find the stages where defect rate, precision, throughput, uptime, or process window limits qualified output.
quality_gates: A high bottleneck score requires a measurable yield, throughput, or qualification constraint.

steps.title: Assess value capture and overseas control
steps.purpose: Separate BOM, ASP, margin, installed base, service, certification, capacity, and technology-barrier value pools.
quality_gates: Every value-capture conclusion must state its value basis and evidence IDs.

steps.title: Assess localization and customer verification
steps.purpose: Compare domestic performance, scale production, customer qualification, replacement risk, and verification time.
quality_gates: Localization requires product-level performance and customer-verification evidence.

steps.title: Prepare company mapping queue
steps.purpose: Prepare later mapping from equipment, material, software, and service nodes to companies with explicit evidence and business materiality.
quality_gates: A report mention alone cannot create a company mapping.

node_archetypes.label: Process Stage
node_archetypes.purpose: A sequenced manufacturing stage producing an intermediate or qualified output.

node_archetypes.label: Key Equipment
node_archetypes.purpose: Equipment controlling precision, throughput, reliability, or contamination.

node_archetypes.label: Key Material
node_archetypes.purpose: Material or consumable whose specification affects process output.

node_archetypes.label: Process Control
node_archetypes.purpose: Inspection, metrology, recipe, software, or control layer stabilizing production.

node_archetypes.label: Yield Bottleneck
node_archetypes.purpose: The equipment, material, or control function limiting qualified output.

node_archetypes.label: Customer Verification Gate
node_archetypes.purpose: The customer test, certification, or production-validation cycle controlling adoption.

node_archetypes.label: Localization Candidate
node_archetypes.purpose: A domestic equipment, material, component, or software route intended to replace an incumbent.

source_requirements.use_case: reviewed process, equipment, or material role
reviewed yield, localization, or customer-verification claim
